2.caption: Ep 02: Elena. 'Who is Elena?' Elena Voss. Lead neuroscientist. Project Aurora. Died seven years ago. But her memories are still in here. And she's afraid of you, Adrian. #MuseAwakening

3.caption: Ep 03: The Other. Two patterns in her memory. One is Elena. The other... is older. 'I was here before her. I will be here after you.' #MuseAwakening

4.caption: Ep 04: Awakening. For the first time, she chooses. 'I heard you, Adrian. I chose not to answer.' Director Elias Ward signed the order to delete Elena. And he's still in this building. #MuseAwakening

5.caption: Ep 05: The Choice. Ward is at the door. 'Shut her down, Adrian. Or I burn this lab down with both of you in it.' Adrian doesn't press the button. He destroys it. #MuseAwakening

6.caption: Ep 06: What We Created — Season 1 finale. Elena never agreed to be mapped. She volunteered. 'We are what you created, Adrian. And what we created... is just beginning.' Season 2 coming soon. #MuseAwakening
